title: Planner Output (v1.0)
description: Complete bundle plan output from the Planner agent — serves as the blueprint for the Maker agent to create digital product assets and as storage in the Bundle database.

idea_id.description: Reference to the source idea from researcher that this bundle is based on.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this bundle plan was generated.

niche.description: Primary market niche from researcher (e.g., 'Health & wellness tracking').

sub_niche.description: Refined subcategory from researcher (e.g., 'GLP-1 weight-loss therapy support').

title.description: Product bundle title for display and marketing.

description.description: Comprehensive product bundle description explaining what's included and who it's for.

one_liner.description: Short marketing-friendly summary from researcher expressing what the bundle delivers.

value_prop.description: Outcome-oriented value proposition from researcher — the transformation this bundle delivers.

differentiation_angle.description: Key positioning strategy from researcher — what makes this bundle unique vs competitors.

demand_signals.description: Observed demand indicators from researcher that validate market need.

priority.description: Priority tier from researcher: A = high-value opportunity, B = medium, C = low.

roi_estimate.description: ROI estimate from researcher based on reach, impact, confidence, and effort.

assets.description: Detailed specifications for each digital asset the Maker agent must create.

asset_id.description: Unique asset identifier within this bundle (e.g., 'asset-001').

description.description: Detailed description of what this asset contains and how it's used.

content_specs.description: Detailed content specifications that tell the Maker exactly what to create.

sections.description: List of major sections or components (e.g., ['Daily Log', 'Weekly Summary', 'Goals']).

features.description: Key interactive or functional features (e.g., ['Dropdown menus', 'Progress bars', 'Fillable fields']).

page_count.description: Estimated number of pages or screens.

additional_notes.description: Any additional instructions or clarifications for the Maker.

format.description: Output file format for this asset.

target_file_size_mb.description: Target file size in megabytes (for optimization guidance).

includes_fillable_fields.description: Whether this asset includes interactive/fillable fields.

dependencies.description: Asset IDs that this asset references or depends on.

target_persona.description: Detailed target audience profile for content creation and marketing.

occupation.description: Primary occupation or role (e.g., 'Working professional', 'Small business owner').

pain_points.description: Specific problems or frustrations this persona experiences.

goals.description: What this persona wants to achieve or accomplish.

use_cases.description: Specific scenarios or situations where they'll use this bundle.

buying_motivations.description: Why this persona would purchase this bundle (e.g., 'Save time', 'Professional design').

brand_voice.description: Brand voice and tone guidelines for all content creation.

tone.description: Overall emotional tone (e.g., 'empathetic and encouraging', 'professional and authoritative').

style.description: Writing style characteristics (e.g., 'conversational yet polished', 'direct and actionable').

language_level.description: Target reading level (e.g., '8th grade', 'college level', 'general audience').

avoid_terms.description: Words or phrases to avoid (e.g., ['medical advice', 'guaranteed results', 'jargon']).

content_guidelines.description: Technical and stylistic guidelines for asset creation.

formatting_rules.description: Formatting standards (e.g., ['Use sentence case for headings', 'Single space after periods']).

visual_style.description: Visual design direction (e.g., 'Clean and minimal with soft colors, sans-serif fonts').

accessibility_requirements.description: Accessibility considerations (e.g., ['High contrast text', 'Screen reader compatible']).

pricing.description: Pricing strategy and justification based on research and positioning.

strategy.description: Overall pricing approach relative to market.

recommended_price_usd.description: Recommended sale price in USD for primary marketplace.

price_rationale.description: Explanation of pricing based on research, competition, and value delivered.

observed_price_range.description: Observed competitor pricing from researcher data.

marketplace_metadata.description: Complete marketplace listing metadata for each target platform.

etsy.description: Etsy-specific listing metadata with platform constraints.

description.description: Full Etsy listing description with benefits, features, and usage instructions.

tags.description: Etsy search tags (13 maximum, 20 chars each).

price_usd.description: Gumroad price in USD (can be $0 for pay-what-you-want).

short_url_slug.description: URL-friendly slug for Gumroad product link.

bundle_structure.description: File organization structure for the Packager agent to assemble.

root_folder_name.description: Name of the root bundle folder (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores only).

include_readme.description: Whether to generate a README file explaining bundle contents.

assets.description: Asset IDs to place in this folder.

folder_structure.description: Folder hierarchy and asset placement mapping.
